defects.what: A purple-to-blue gradient header, emoji in every title and rounded shadowed cards: any SaaS template.
At 390 px the page scrolls sideways: the three 220 px cards stay in one row.
« Découvrir » acts as a button but keeps the default cursor.
White text on the pink « Découvrir » button, below AA.
Another header: a black bar, green capitals, the links in another order and « home » in English.
The « Ajouter » buttons keep the default cursor.
« Prix TTC, livraison offerte dès 50 € » is light grey on white, below AA.
A third header, orange monospace, with only Accueil and Aide.
A dark terminal style that no other page shares.
« ENVOYER » is a div with the default cursor.
The order list stays blank: nothing says there is no order, or what to do.
The call to /api/orders fails and leaves an error in the console.
« Mes commandes » is not in the home menu: the customer has to guess it is behind Produits.
The way to the orders goes through the products page, a detour.
At the end, the order list is blank.
« Ajouter » does nothing anyone can see.
« Envoyé » shows in an alert while the message goes nowhere.
